ld_ripple_mv.source: under 0.4 % of the LD voltage at half duty, so the LED current carries no visible 20 kHz part (0.185 x 5 mV / 2.74 ohm = 0.3 mA)

t_settle_ms.source: a brightness step within 99 % in 40 ms: a fade the eye reads as smooth, the firmware's 25 ms steps (README, Firmware)

ld_full.source: full duty reaches 95 mA or more and stays within the LD range (0.2 to 1.5 V, DS20005588B Eq. 3-3; over 1.5 V the 275 mV reference holds it at 100 mA)

ld_mean.source: half duty is half the range: the firmware's brightness table is linear in duty
